retrievalProfile.description: A centered, black-bordered monochrome photograph set against a wide, textured parchment-style margin with top-aligned serif typography.
triggerTerms: framed black and white portrait with wide margins
textured paper background with inset photo
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif or brutalist styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular black and white photograph is enclosed by a thick black border. This assembly is placed on a larger square canvas featuring a subtle, warm-toned parchment texture. The typography is positioned in the upper right quadrant, utilizing a classic serif font with a mix of roman and italic styles.
coreVisualRelationships: The thick black frame acts as a transition between the high-contrast photo and the soft-textured background.
The text is anchored to the top edge of the internal photo frame.
The subject in the photo is positioned off-center to balance the negative space of the background.
The warm beige of the background provides a neutral counterpoint to the stark black and white of the image.
coreInvariants: A thick, solid black border must surround the central image.
The background must have a visible paper or parchment texture.
The typography must be placed in the upper margin, right-aligned to the image edge.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-shot portrait, occupying the right two-thirds of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black-bordered photograph serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the text in the top right, moves down to the subject's face, and then follows the diagonal lines of the background scenery within the photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space is provided by the wide parchment-textured margins surrounding the central frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black frame and the light background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, and sepia/beige tones

letterConstructionRules: Small x-height for an elegant feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized secondary text for emphasis and rhythm

composition.relationshipToImage: aligned to the right edge of the photo frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Roman serif for the title paired with its italic counterpart for the artist name, separated by a colon.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic proportions and elegant italics match the sophisticated tone.
Clean, readable old-style serif that feels timeless.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square canvas with a light beige parchment texture. In the center, place a horizontal rectangular black and white photograph of a man in a dark coat, surrounded by a thick, solid black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of serif text in the top right margin, aligned with the right edge of the black frame. Use a mix of roman and italic styles in black ink.

verificationChecks: Is the photo strictly black and white?
Is there a thick black border around the photo?
Is the background a textured parchment color?
Is the text right-aligned to the photo frame?

adjustableVariables: Aspect ratio of the internal photograph
mustRedesign: Avoid using modern digital fonts like Arial or Helvetica
Do not use pure white for the background; it must be textured
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the image frame.
Verify the parchment texture is subtle and not distracting.
Check that the black border is uniform in thickness.
Confirm the subject's face is clear and well-lit within the monochrome photo.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square Canvas + Parchment Texture + Centered Framed B&W Photo + Top-Right Serif Text
